title: Lora loading fail on Flux 2 dev for FAL loras
author: christopher5106

comments.author: christopher5106
comments.body:
Another  example "fal/FLUX.2-dev-Turbo" with a lot more keys:

### Reproduction

```python
import torch
from diffusers import Flux2Pipeline

pipe = Flux2Pipeline.from_pretrained("black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-dev", torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16)
pipe.load_lora_weights("fal/FLUX.2-dev-Turbo")
```
